name: Recruitment Lead Time Report
query:
SELECT
    ja.position_title AS "Vị trí:Data:180",
    ja.department AS "Phòng ban:Link/Department:160",
    COUNT(ja.name) AS "Tổng ứng viên:Int:120",
    COUNT(first_interview.first_interview_at) AS "Đã phỏng vấn:Int:120",
    ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ja.creation, first_interview.first_interview_at) / 86400), 2) AS "TB nhận hồ sơ đến phỏng vấn đầu tiên (ngày):Float:220",
    COUNT(offer.offer_sent_at) AS "Đã gửi offer:Int:120",
    ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ja.creation, offer.offer_sent_at) / 86400), 2) AS "TB nhận hồ sơ đến gửi offer (ngày):Float:220",
    COUNT(hire.hired_at) AS "Đã tuyển:Int:100",
    ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ja.creation, hire.hired_at) / 86400), 2) AS "TB nhận hồ sơ đến tuyển (ngày):Float:220"
FROM `tabJob Applicant` ja
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT job_applicant, MIN(start_time) AS first_interview_at
    FROM `tabInterview`
    WHERE status IN ('In Progress', 'Completed')
    GROUP BY job_applicant
) first_interview ON first_interview.job_applicant = ja.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT job_applicant, MIN(sent_at) AS offer_sent_at
    FROM `tabJob Offer`
    WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL
        AND offer_status IN ('Sent', 'Accepted', 'Declined', 'Expired')
    GROUP BY job_applicant
) offer ON offer.job_applicant = ja.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT job_applicant, MIN(accepted_at) AS hired_at
    FROM `tabJob Offer`
    WHERE offer_status = 'Accepted'
        AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY job_applicant
) hire ON hire.job_applicant = ja.name
GROUP BY ja.position_title, ja.department
ORDER BY ja.position_title, ja.department
